book.name: REVELATION
book.title: Matsh Haschu g Jesus Christ am i Maskogi John Wui

content: Mash hema g anghil an uꞌukch g holiwk oꞌohana

Ntki hahawa ab nei matki ab hema i hud g s-gewk anghil ab dahm kahchim amjed. Id oki g chewagikaj e enigadadch ch g kiohod an hab juhkch e-moꞌo an. Kuki g wuhioshaj hab mahs mo g tash. K g kakhioj hab mahs mo g mehi am wuhshanim.
Id oki g s-apko e-tadkaj am keishch g ge shuhdagi ch g s-ohgig e-tadkaj am keishch g jewed. Kuki an hab chuꞌig g oꞌohana nowij ed ch pi holiwkas.
Kuki am si s-kaidam neok ch hab sha kaidag mo g mawid ab todk. Kutki g wewaꞌak tataniki ab hahawa uhpam neneo todkch.
Nt am haha wabsh wo i chum oꞌoha. Tki wabshaba ab hema neo dahm kahchim t amjed k hab kaij, “Pi g am hedai shaꞌi ahgid mo has kaij idam wewaꞌak tataniki. Pi g an hu shaꞌi oꞌohan.”
Kutki ihda anghil mo an dahm kehk g ge kahchki ch jewed ab si uhgk i bei g s-apkojed e-nowi ab dahm kahchim wui
k hab kaij, “Jiosh o chum hekid an haꞌichug ch nahto g dahm kahchim ch jewed kahchim ch ge kahchki ch wehs haꞌichu mo am ha eda idam k hab kaij mat am wa e ai mat geꞌe haꞌichu hab wo e juh.
Wewaꞌakkokam anghil at am wo kuhu g e-kuikudkaj. T am hab haha wo juh g Jiosh g s-aꞌagi e-apchuda mo wa am ha ahgid hegam e-pionagbad mo d Jiosh haꞌichu i tashogiddam.”
Kutki hegai mo wa ab neok ni-wui ab dahm kahchim t amjed ab ep neok k hab kaij, “Neh, an o uꞌukch g oꞌohana hegai anghil mo an dahm kehk g kahchki ch jewed. Am g hihm k ab behꞌi.”
Nt am hih wui hegai anghil k ab tahni mat wo ni-mah. K hab kaij ab ni-wui, “Ab g be k huhgi. T wo si s-iꞌowik mapt wo huh ch wabshaba wo siwa am m-wohk ed.”
Nt ab bei g al oꞌohana nowij ab k huh. K s-wohom si s-iꞌowi mant huh. Nt wabshaba am i bah. T hahawa si siwa am ni-wohk ed.
Kum ab hahawa ep ni-ahgid ihda, “Am apt ep wo oꞌoha g Jiosh haꞌichu ahga ab ha amjed muꞌi nahnko mahs mehk jewed dakam hemajkam ch kokownal ch nahnko kaidam neneokdam.”
